provenance: Hand-authored passive-account expectations; none obtained from production execution.
entry_policy: One attempt per instrument at the earliest evaluation open with a preceding completed minute. No accumulation, stop, target or rebalance. Alphabetical simultaneous order priority.
allocation: Equal initial notional weights capped by symbol and aggregate exposure, subject to actual marked-equity/cash/fee and prior-minute participation constraints. Exposure limits apply at entry. Passive drift is not rebalanced.
cash_policy: Same initial capital and eligible session closes, zero interest, no trades or fees.
